entries.finding: Mahakasyapa is retained as the named non-answering participant in all six parallel cases without being made utterer; the headword deployment remains coherent.
Narrator, attendant, master, quoted-case owner, and later raiser layers are now correctly separated; Lia'an no longer owns Dongshan's token.
Visitor, layperson, Yuntong, and Shoushan question ownership is restored at turn level; the polite inquiry formula remains one coherent usage.
Documentary vow-makers are now retained contextually while narration remains narrator-owned; no actor substitution remains.
Staff holders and commentator are restored and mixed Baichi/Baoshou evidence is recut, resolving the complete-case actor defect without changing the supported implement sense.
